outputs.text: Thank you for sharing your experience, Rohit. We are glad to hear that you found the desk exercises helpful for your back. Please feel free to reach out to Gomti Physio & Rehab if you need any further assistance in the future.

Dear Neha, we are sincerely sorry for the long wait and the rushed experience during your visit. We strive to provide timely and attentive care, and we regret that we fell short this time. Please contact our clinic directly so we can discuss this further and improve our service.

Hi Amit, thank you for your feedback. Hum khush hain ki aapko hamari guidance achhi lagi aur parking issue ke liye hum apologize karte hain. Agar aapko clinic visit ke baare mein kuch aur discuss karna ho, toh please humein offline contact karein.

सुनीता जी, आपकी प्रतिक्रिया के लिए बहुत-बहुत धन्यवाद। हमारी टीम हमेशा हर व्यक्ति को बेहतर सहयोग और सेवा देने का प्रयास करती है। यदि आपको कभी भी हमारी किसी अन्य सेवा की आवश्यकता हो, तो कृपया हमारे क्लिनिक से संपर्क करें।

Thank you so much, Pooja! Humein yeh sunkar bahut khushi hui ki aapke bete ka first dental visit achha raha aur wo bilkul nahi dare. Humari family dental clinic mein sabhi ke comfort ka pura dhyan rakha jata hai.

Hi Vikas, hum aapke experience se bahut disappointed hain aur is inconvenience ke liye sincere apology chahte hain. Hum chahte hain ki aap hamare saath offline connect karein taaki hum aapki baat sun sakein. Aap hume clinic par contact kar sakte hain.

Hello Karan. We are sorry to hear that your experience with our waiting area and reception was less than ideal. We truly appreciate your feedback and are always looking for ways to improve our service. Please feel free to reach out to us directly so we can ensure a better experience moving forward.

Thank you for your kind review, Shreya. We are glad you had a great experience with our routine check-up and cleaning service and appreciated our hygiene standards. We look forward to welcoming you back to Smile Craft Dental whenever you need us.

Thank you so much for your lovely feedback, Ananya! We are so glad your bridal makeup stayed perfect throughout your special day. It was an absolute pleasure having you at Glow Studio Salon, and we wish you all the best ✨

Hi Meera, I am truly sorry for the wait and that your hair colour did not turn out as you expected. We always want your time at Glow Studio Salon to be seamless and satisfying. Please reach out to us directly so we can discuss this with you further. ✨
Hi Ritu, thank you so much for the lovely feedback! Khushi hui ye jaan kar ki aapko facial pasand aaya aur aapki skin glow kar rahi hai. ✨ Hum aapko salon mein fir se welcome karne ka wait karenge!
Thank you for your support, Sana! We always love having you at Glow Studio Salon and look forward to your next visit ✨

Hey Sandeep, thank you so much for dropping by with your family! Khushi hui ye sunkar ki aapko Sunday thali aur dal makhani ka swad pasand aaya. Hum apni family dining ko aise hi special rakhne ki koshish karte hain, aur jald hi aapko phir se serve karne ka intezaar rahega!

Hi Isha, I am truly sorry to hear that your tandoori starters arrived cold and that you received this kind of service from our team. We always want every meal to be warm and freshly prepared for our guests. Please reach out to us offline so we can discuss this with you directly and make things right.

Gaurav, thank you for the feedback, aur humein khushi hai ki aapko food mast laga! Weekend rush aur parking ki dikkat ke liye humein khed hai, aapki yeh baat hamare liye important hai. Agli baar aane se pehle aap humse contact kar sakte hain, hum aapka swagat karne ke liye hamesha taiyar hain.

Hi Tara, thanks for sharing your feedback with us. We are glad to hear our service was polite, but we are sorry the food did not quite hit the mark for you. We hope to welcome you back to Tandoor Junction soon for an even better meal.

It is wonderful to hear that you felt supported as a beginner starting your fitness journey at IronCore Fitness. Building a solid foundation and proper form makes all the difference. Thank you for sharing your experience with us, Divya.

Hi Rahul, I am truly sorry to hear about your experience with the equipment and that your concerns weren't addressed properly. We always want our members to have reliable access to our strength floor and cardio equipment. Please reach out to us directly so we can look into this matter further.

Hi Faizan, thanks for sharing your feedback. Hum khush hain ki trainers aapko helpful lage, lekin evening rush ki wajah se wait karna padta hai iske liye humein khed hai. Agar aap thode off-peak hours try karna chahein toh shayad aur bhi behtar experience milega.
नेहा, आयरनकोर फिटनेस में आपके अनुभव के लिए बहुत-बहुत धन्यवाद। हमारे ट्रेनर और माहौल को सराहा जाना हमारे लिए बहुत प्रेरणादायक है। हम आगे भी आपकी फिटनेस यात्रा में ऐसे ही सहायता करते रहेंगे।

Thanks Mohit ji, aapka review padhkar accha laga ki hum aapki screen replacement mein timely help kar paaye aur aapko bill bhi mil gaya. Aise hi kisi bhi accessory ya repair ke liye Sharma Mobile & Accessories par dobara zaroor aana.

Suresh, hume yeh sunkar bohot afsos hua ki aapko naye phone ke sath charging ki problem face karni padi. Hum samajh sakte hain ki yeh kitna frustrating hai, aur hum aapse request karte hain ki aap humse direct contact karein taaki hum is matter ko properly address kar sakein.

Hi Kunal, thanks for visiting Sharma Mobile & Accessories and for sharing your thoughts about our smartphone selection and accessories. We appreciate your feedback regarding the space and are always working to serve our customers better during busy times. We hope to see you again soon.

Thank you for visiting Sharma Mobile & Accessories, Zoya. We are glad to hear that you had a quick and smooth process exchanging your old phone with us. We appreciate your support and hope to see you again soon!

राजेश जी, आपकी बेटी की सफलता देखकर बहुत खुशी हुई। हम कक्षा १० के गणित और विज्ञान के लिए साप्ताहिक टेस्ट और डाउट क्लासेज नियमित रूप से आयोजित करते हैं। आपकी यह प्रतिक्रिया हमारे सभी शिक्षकों के लिए बहुत प्रोत्साहन देने वाली है।
अनीता जी, आपकी बात के लिए धन्यवाद और आपके अनुभव के लिए हमें खेद है। हम इस विषय पर बात करना चाहते हैं, कृपया हमारे संस्थान से संपर्क करें ताकि हम आपकी इस समस्या का उचित समाधान निकाल सकें।

Prakash ji, thank you for your feedback. Hum khush hain ki aapko teachers aur test series pasand aayi. Class timings ke baare mein aapki baat note kar li gayi hai, aur aap is par aage baat karne ke liye humse directly contact kar sakte hain.

Thank you for sharing your feedback, Meenal. We are glad to hear that the weekly tests and parent updates are helping your son stay on track with his JEE foundation preparation at Vidya Path Classes. We appreciate your trust in us and remain committed to supporting his growth.

If you are spending long hours at a desk or getting back into sports in the local area, Gomti Physio & Rehab is here to support your physical wellbeing. Our team provides services ranging from posture correction for desk workers to sports injury rehabilitation and post-surgery physiotherapy. You can visit our clinic Monday through Saturday from 9 am to 7 pm for a session, and no doctor's referral is needed for a first assessment. Feel free to contact us to learn more about how we can help you move better.

Gomti Nagar ke office workers aur post-surgery recovery wale sabhi log ke liye, Gomti Physio & Rehab team yahan hai. Hum sports injury rehabilitation aur post-surgery physiotherapy services provide karte hain. Aap Monday to Saturday subah 9 baje se shaam 7 baje tak humse connect kar sakte hain.

Kothrud ke families aur college students ke liye, Smile Craft Dental lekar aaye hain ek khaas mauka. Har mahine ke pehle Sunday ko subah 10 baje se dopehar 1 baje tak free dental check-up camp ka labh uthayein (yeh offer 31 March 2027 tak valid hai). Hum Monday se Saturday, subah 10 am se raat 8 pm tak khule hain.

Drop by Smile Craft Dental in Kothrud for our free dental check-up camp happening on the first Sunday of the month from 10 am to 1 pm, valid until 2027-03-31. Families and college students can also visit us Monday to Saturday from 10 am to 8 pm for routine check-ups and cleanings, root canal treatments, or braces and aligners.

Looking to refresh your look with a new haircut or hair colour this season? Glow Studio Salon in Vaishali Nagar is here for all your styling and bridal makeup needs every day from 10 am to 9 pm. Walk-ins are welcome, and appointments get priority. ✨

Step into Glow Studio Salon in Vaishali Nagar for a relaxing refresh with our expert hair and skin care services. Whether you are planning your bridal look or needing a new haircut, we are here to help you feel your best every day. Walk-ins are welcome, though appointments receive priority. ✨

Hey families aur office groups! Tandoor Junction mein aa jaiye aur enjoy kijiye hamari Sunday family thali — ₹349, jo ki ek person ke liye unlimited thali hai (valid until 2027-06-30). Yeh offer har Sunday ke liye perfect hai jab aap kuch tasty aur hearty khana chahte hain. Hum roz subah 11 am se raat 11 pm tak open hain, toh aaj hi family dining ke liye visit karein! 🍽️

Gather your family or office group for a delicious meal at Tandoor Junction in Vijay Nagar! Try our Sunday family thali for ₹349, featuring an unlimited thali for one, valid until June 30, 2027. We are open every day from 11 am to 11 pm for all your family dining and tandoori starter cravings.

If you are an IT professional in Madhapur looking to build a consistent fitness routine, IronCore Fitness is here to support your goals. Drop by to explore our strength floor, join our group cardio classes, or work directly with our personal trainers. We are open Monday to Saturday from 5 am to 10 pm, and Sundays from 7 am to 1 am, to fit your busy schedule.

Balancing long hours at the desk with steady physical activity helps keep your energy high all week. Drop by IronCore Fitness in Madhapur to check out our strength floor and group cardio classes. Whether you are stepping into a gym for the first time or returning to a routine, our team is here to support your goals.

Namaste Laxmi Nagar ke students aur families! Agar aap naye smartphones, chargers aur accessories ki talash mein hain, toh Sharma Mobile & Accessories zaroor aayein. Humare yahan phone repair aur screen replacement ke sath-sath purane phones ka exchange bhi kiya jata hai. Har naye phone ke sath GST bill aur brand warranty milti hai. Hum roz subah 10:30 am se raat 9 pm tak khule hain.

Laxmi Nagar ke aas-paas ke sabhi students aur families ke liye Sharma Mobile & Accessories par naye smartphones, chargers aur accessories available hain. Humare yahan phone repair aur screen replacement ke sath-sath purane phones ka exchange bhi kiya jata hai. Har phone ke sath GST bill aur brand warranty milti hai. Hum roz subah 10:30 am se raat 9 pm tak khule hain.

विद्या पाथ क्लासेस बोरिंग रोड पर कक्षा 9 से 12 के गणित और विज्ञान के लिए कोचिंग संस्थान है। हमारे यहां साप्ताहिक टेस्ट और डाउट क्लासेज की सुविधा के साथ जेईई फाउंडेशन बैच भी संचालित किया जाता है। छात्र और अभिभावक सोमवार से शनिवार, दोपहर 3 बजे से शाम 8 बजे के बीच हमसे जुड़ सकते हैं। पहली क्लास का डेमो बिल्कुल मुफ्त उपलब्ध है।

Welcome to a new week of learning and growth at Vidya Path Classes on Boring Road! Our coaching institute is open Monday to Saturday from 3 pm to 8 pm to support students in classes 9 to 12 with maths and science. We encourage all school students and their parents to visit us and experience our classes firsthand.

Welcome to Gomti Physio & Rehab, a physiotherapy clinic in Gomti Nagar dedicated to helping office workers, sportspeople and individuals recovering from surgery. We provide back and neck pain assessment, post-surgery physiotherapy, posture correction for desk workers, and sports injury rehabilitation. Sessions are about 45 minutes, and no referral is needed for a first assessment. We are open Monday to Saturday from 9 am to 7 pm. Please feel free to reach out with any questions about our services.

Welcome to Smile Craft Dental, a family dental clinic in Kothrud welcoming families and college students. We provide a friendly space for routine check-up and cleaning, root canal treatment, braces and aligners, and children's dentistry. Local anaesthesia is used during root canal procedures, and the dentist explains each step before starting. 

Visit us for a routine check-up, root canal treatment, or braces. We are open Monday to Saturday from 10 am to 8 pm. Additionally, a free dental check-up camp priced at ₹0 is available on the first Sunday of the month from 10 am to 1 pm, valid until 2027-03-31.

Welcome to our unisex beauty salon in Vaishali Nagar! We are delighted to welcome young professionals and brides-to-be for a fresh, stylish experience. Our team provides professional services including a precision haircut, vibrant hair colour, relaxing facials and skin care, and complete bridal makeup. Walk-ins are always welcome, though appointments receive priority. Visit us every day between 10 am and 9 pm to refresh your look. ✨

Welcome to Tandoor Junction, a casual family restaurant in Vijay Nagar serving hearty meals every day from 11 am to 11 pm. We welcome families and office groups for cozy family dining and group gatherings. Enjoy our signature North Indian thali, flavorful tandoori starters, and convenient party orders. Please note that party orders of 20 or more need a day's notice. Drop by to experience our delicious food, including our current offer: Sunday family thali — ₹349 (valid until 2027-06-30): unlimited thali for one.

Welcome to our gym in Madhapur, designed for IT professionals and first-time gym-goers looking to build a consistent fitness routine. We feature a dedicated strength floor, group cardio classes, and experienced personal trainers to support your goals. New visitors can begin with our beginner onboarding process, and a one-day trial pass is available at the front desk. Whether you want to focus on strength training or join our group cardio classes and personal training sessions, our facility is open Monday to Saturday from 5 am to 10 pm, and Sunday from 7 am to 1 pm. Drop by to see our space and start your fitness journey today.

Welcome to Sharma Mobile & Accessories, your local mobile phone shop in Laxmi Nagar, proudly serving students and families nearby. We offer a wide range of new smartphones, chargers and accessories. If you need assistance with your device, we provide reliable in-house phone repair and screen replacement services. You can also conveniently exchange your old phones with us. Every phone purchase comes complete with a GST bill and the official brand warranty. Visit us any day of the week between 10:30 am and 9 pm for helpful service with all your mobile needs.

Vidya Path Classes Boring Road par school students aur parents ka swagat hai. Humare coaching institute mein class 9 to 12 maths and science aur JEE foundation batch ke liye classes uplabdh hain. Students ki behtar taiyari ke liye hum weekly tests, doubt classes aur parent-teacher meetings conduct karte hain. Aapka pehla class free demo hota hai. Humare yahan Monday to Saturday, 3 pm to 8 pm tak padhai hoti hai. Humare saath judkar apni padhai ko aage badhayein.
